data.title: Electricity price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH announces a price increase for the MusterStrom Flex tariff from 1 November 2026. Yearly costs rise from €577.08 to €647.28, and the monthly prepayment rises from €48.00 to €54.00 from 15 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising its prices. The usage price goes from 32.90 to 36.40 ct/kWh and the base fee from €11.90 to €13.90 per month. Your monthly prepayment (Abschlag) rises to €54.00 from 15 November 2026. You have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without a notice period, but the cancellation must reach the provider before the increase takes effect. You can decide whether to cancel or stay; the app shows until when you can cancel. You could compare other tariffs first.
